roles.calibration_and_selection: VAL887 previously exposed development; supervised GT constraints
roles.test: Only selected frozen VAL-passing arm; exposed TEST1440 reporting, no reselection

calibration: Once per score, global risk cutoff=max first whole-tie threshold retaining ceil(.95*good) in all/domain/video groups. GT only offline. Control working points are newly named copies, original policy not overwritten.

gate.overall: Strictly fewer matched-count FA than BOTH full_simple and score controls; use conservative minimum FA at boundary ties
gate.strata: All/domain/video good retention >=95%; matched-count FA does not increase against either control
gate.continuity: Longest unavailable observed consecutive run does not increase against either same-count control in any stratum; zero extra frames allowed

selection_rule: Only gate-passing candidates. Lowest global FA then highest global CR at their VAL cutoff; exact tie retains original policy. Neither passes: stop and never access TEST. No further regularization, combinations, losses, heads, budgets or thresholds searched.
protection: Center/angle decisions and angle risk copied from original simple; final original M box/score/output identity exact. Size only. Original B24/sigma1.5/epoch03 and old sigma1 history immutable.
interpretation: Beating original simple without score is only reduced feature harm, not a new ranking advantage; failure bounds this fixed linear setup, not all information in the descriptors. VAL fitting/selection empirical, TEST repeatedly exposed; no mechanical safety guarantee.
